turnkey-vnm

## What to build

A shared rule helper turns a rule's ExternalRunnerTestInfo arguments into their cache-enabled form. It sets: supports_test_execution_caching; the cache-reading default_executor (never the execution platform); project-relative paths and cwd; declared env PATH restricted to Nix store paths; declared env HOME=/homeless-shelter. rust_test calls it through a prelude patch. The generated .buckconfig gains `[buck2_re_client]` addresses for the local endpoint (fixed loopback port, tls off). The runner is still off, so behaviour is unchanged (spec §4, §7).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] rust_test targets emit the cache-enabled provider through the helper
- [ ] Build actions still execute locally, and `tk build` never contacts a cache
- [ ] Rust tests pass with the pinned PATH and HOME
- [ ] With the runner off and no server running, `tk test` behaves exactly as before, with no connection attempts

## Blocked by

- turnkey-vnm.2
